question: The _____ on 5 April 2024 launched India’s first-ever book on Sports Psychology.

options.text: Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University (TNPES)

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)** launched India's first-ever book on Sports Psychology on 5 April 2024.
 
• The book aims to provide comprehensive insights into the psychological aspects of sports and athletic performance.
 
• This initiative by IISM marks a significant milestone in the field of sports education and research in India.
 
• The book is intended to serve as a valuable resource for athletes, coaches, sports psychologists, and students of sports management and psychology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sports Psychology**:

 
 
• Sports psychology involves the study of how psychological factors affect performance and how participation in sports and exercise affect psychological and physical factors.
 
• Key areas include motivation, performance anxiety, and the psychological benefits of sports and exercise.
 
• Sports psychologists work with athletes to improve performance and increase motivation.
 
• They also help athletes cope with the pressures of competition and recover from injuries.
 
 
 
• **International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)**:
 
 
• Founded in 2010, IISM is India's premier sports management education institute.
 
• It offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses in sports management.
 
• IISM collaborates with various sports organizations and professionals to provide practical training and exposure to its students.
 
• The institute aims to contribute to the professional development of the sports industry in India.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Sports Psychology**:
 
 
• Enhances athletic performance by improving focus and mental resilience.
 
• Helps in managing stress and anxiety associated with competitive sports.
 
• Assists athletes in setting realistic goals and maintaining motivation.
 
• Supports injury recovery by addressing the psychological impact of injuries.
 
 
 
• **Psychological Skills Training (PST)**:
 
 
• PST involves techniques such as visualization, self-talk, and relaxation training.
 
• These techniques help athletes enhance their mental skills and improve their performance.
 
• Regular practice of PST can lead to better focus, confidence, and coping strategies.
